predictions.what: capacity unit sizes: N39C about 0.6-0.8 l (N30C 2.4-3.2 l, N24 7.2-9.6 l, N01 72-96 l), alias x9-12 (N39C 5-7 l)
predictions.src: pe16, pe55, pe59 P1; pe57: untestable on open data
predictions.would_support: Proto-Elamite-period standard vessels (Susa III, Malyan Banesh, Yahya IVC) with capacity modes near 0.7 l, 2.8 l and 8.4 l (or 5-7 l), beating random vessel sets (pe57 calibration: random sets pass 33-50%)
predictions.would_kill: a measured PE-period vessel series with no mode in 0.5-1.0 l, 2-3.5 l or 4-9 l

predictions.what: Yahya set: new Tepe Yahya tablets carry M056 / M044 / M219 / M136 and Susa tablets rarely carry two of them
predictions.would_support: >= 1 of the 4 on >= 30% of >= 20 new Yahya tablets (corpus 16/27), above the Susa rate (corpus 222/1502 = 15%), and new Susa tablets rarely carry two of them (pe66: 5 vs 19.7 expected)
predictions.would_kill: 40+ new Yahya tablets with none of the four, or a new-Yahya rate at or below the Susa rate

predictions.what: sealed-type rules: new sealed tablets are short, headed (M157 more often than unsealed), carry M288 lines and fewer capacity lines; meaning = signed-for per-head disbursement (C); |M153+X| compounds mark the sealing party (C)
predictions.would_support: on >= 40 new sealed tablets: M157-header share above and capacity-line share below the unsealed rates of the same archive; a new |M153+...| tablet with a PES0329/0333/0334 impression
predictions.would_kill: >= 40 new sealed tablets with header M157 and capacity lines at unsealed rates (15.8% / 38%); >= 3 new |M153+...| tablets with well-preserved unsealed surfaces

predictions.what: per-head rule: a bare 'M288 n' line directly after a count line ending in a PERSON-class sign holds 60 N39C = 2(N39B) 1(N24) per unit (sometimes 120); 'signs + M288' lines follow no per-unit rule
predictions.src: pe27, pe63 D3, pe66 F6, pe69 F2; pe72 held-out

pe64_L1.text: On tablets not in this corpus, a count line ending in M054, M388 or M124 followed by a bare M288 line has M288 = 60 N39C x count.
pe64_L1.support: >= 1 in 3 of at least 6 such new pairs
pe64_L1.kill: < 1 in 6 of at least 6 new pairs

predictions.would_support: >= 50% of >= 15 new such pairs at 60k or 120k N39C (random-unit twins: 0%)
predictions.would_kill: < 1 in 6 of >= 15 new pairs (pe64 L1), or a 30 or 20 per-unit rung on >= 10 new tablets (pe64 L2)

predictions.what: broken-tablet completions: lost M288 values, lost team counts, total gaps and join candidates
predictions.note: pe69: team-count predictions withdrawn (team rule killed); the per-line rule fails on damaged runs (4/14 vs 8.4), so every completion is C
predictions.would_support: >= 50% of restored values match on the first 10 joins or collations
predictions.would_kill: kill lines as frozen in the pe68/pe69 files (e.g. >= 3 of the first 5 restored M288 values off-rule)

predictions.what: header slot: |M327+M342| and M005~a stand in the header line
predictions.would_support: >= 80% of new |M327+M342| in the header line; M005~a header share > 3x plain M005
predictions.would_kill: < 50% of >= 10 new |M327+M342| in the header line; M005~a header share <= plain M005 on >= 10 new

predictions.what: MEASURED-class final signs (incl. grain-office C+ M081 M265 M266 M296 M112 M286 M248) take capacity numerals; COUNTED-class never
predictions.would_kill: MEASURED <= base capacity rate; COUNTED < 85% non-capacity

predictions.what: totals: a single reverse numeric line equals the entry sum in the tablet system; no sign marks totals
predictions.would_support: >= 10% of new clean totalled tablets close
predictions.would_kill: < 4% close; a sign on > 40% of new total lines

predictions.what: dossier rule: a new copy of a pe63 template series keeps the series header and number system
predictions.would_support: >= 4 of 5 new copies keep header and system

predictions.what: class-sign weights (pe52/pe58 directions): an entry with the sign lies above (+) / below (-) its same-system siblings
predictions.note: held-out 58%, the same as frequency-matched decoy signs (58%); pe52 support line was >= 70%
predictions.would_support: >= 70% on >= 20 new cases AND above decoy signs

predictions.what: edge tag: top-edge 1(N34) is commoner on M157-headed tablets and never a sum
decoding new Susa tablets with the frozen v2 reading gives the held-out rates +- 10 points
predictions.would_support: rates within +- 10 points on >= 50 new tablets (e.g. the 88 Tehran Susa tablets once transliterated)
predictions.would_kill: dense rate below the shuffled-role twin rate (10.6%)

predictions.what: independent offices, not a Susa-centred state; outposts write about local goods only as "local to one site"
predictions.would_kill: a new outpost archive predicted from Susa with held-out gain >= 0.2 (pe65)
